svg.title: Teklo Study
svg.desc: Banner: the four fan-made Quantum Evo cards (Nexus, Processor, Controller, Tower) above a win-rate chart, next to the project title and its tools: Python, Jupyter, scikit-learn, pandas, Hugging Face.
svg.text: Dream cards for Teklovossen, a game simulator
and a win-rate model, built to learn machine learning.
Fan-made, educational project. Not affiliated with Legend Story Studios.
